FINAL IVX ENTERPRISE PRODUCTION CERTIFICATION
EXECUTE — DO NOT RETURN ANOTHER NARRATIVE REPORT

The platform is in the final production phase.

From this point forward, every item must be verified with LIVE EVIDENCE.

Do NOT add new features.
Do NOT redesign the UI.
Do NOT skip any module.
Fix every production issue before certifying.

====================================================
PHASE 1 — AUTHENTICATION (100%)
====================================================

Verify end-to-end:

✓ Member Sign Up
✓ Member Sign In
✓ Owner Sign In
✓ Investor Sign In
✓ Buyer Sign In
✓ Logout
✓ Session Persistence
✓ Remember Me
✓ Token Refresh
✓ Session Expiration
✓ Browser Refresh
✓ App Restart
✓ Duplicate Registration
✓ Duplicate Email
✓ Weak Password
✓ Invalid Email
✓ Wrong Password
✓ Password Change
✓ Forgot Password
✓ Password Reset
✓ Email Verification
✓ Resend Verification
✓ Account Recovery
✓ Network Retry
✓ Offline Recovery
✓ Rate Limiting
✓ Auto Logout
✓ Role Authorization
✓ JWT Validation
✓ RLS Policies

Run on:

• Samsung Browser
• Android Chrome
• iPhone Safari
• Desktop Chrome
• Desktop Safari
• Expo Android
• Expo iOS
• Production APK

====================================================
PHASE 2 — MEMBERS
====================================================

Verify:

✓ Registration creates exactly ONE auth user
✓ ONE profile
✓ ONE member
✓ ONE investment profile
✓ No duplicate rows
✓ No orphan rows
✓ Correct role
✓ Correct KYC status
✓ Correct timestamps
✓ Correct synchronization

Verify Admin updates immediately.

====================================================
PHASE 3 — LANDING PAGE
====================================================

Audit every section.

Hero

Statistics

Properties

Featured Deals

Reels

Invest button

Join button

Registration

Footer

Navigation

Every button.

Every animation.

Every image.

Every API.

Every link.

Verify:

No blank cards

No stale cache

No layout shift

No broken image

No console errors

No JavaScript errors

No missing API

====================================================
PHASE 4 — REELS
====================================================

Instagram-quality certification.

Run:

500 scroll cycles

200 open/close cycles

100 background/foreground cycles

100 network interruptions

100 orientation changes

30-minute playback

60-minute playback

Verify:

No crash

No freeze

No duplicate video

No missing thumbnail

No memory leak

No audio loss

No black frame

No loading spinner loop

No stale cache

====================================================
PHASE 5 — EVERY MODULE
====================================================

Audit:

Landing

Home

Invest

Portfolio

Market

Reels

Members

Investors

Buyers

Properties

Deals

JV Deals

Messages

Notifications

Analytics

CRM

Payments

Documents

Media

Reports

Settings

Variables

Owner Dashboard

Admin Hub

Developer Dashboard

AI Chat

Verify:

Create

Read

Update

Delete

Upload

Download

Publish

Unpublish

Reorder

Search

Filter

Pagination

Synchronization

====================================================
PHASE 6 — UI CONSISTENCY
====================================================

Every screen must use:

Official IVX Logo

Official Gold

Official Black

Official Typography

Official Icons

Official Cards

Official Buttons

Official Spacing

Official Animations

Remove ALL legacy branding.

====================================================
PHASE 7 — PERFORMANCE
====================================================

Measure:

FPS

CPU

Memory

JS Thread

Render Thread

Bundle Size

Image Size

Video Size

Database Query Time

API Response

Cold Start

Warm Start

Largest Contentful Paint

Time To Interactive

====================================================
PHASE 8 — SECURITY
====================================================

Verify:

JWT

Bearer Tokens

RLS

SQL Injection

XSS

CSRF

Rate Limit

Owner-only Routes

Admin-only Routes

Member-only Routes

API Authorization

Storage Permissions

Secret Loading

No hardcoded credentials

MFA remains OPTIONAL and configurable only from Settings (OFF by default unless the owner enables it).

====================================================
PHASE 9 — DATABASE
====================================================

Verify:

No duplicate members

No duplicate investors

No duplicate buyers

No duplicate deals

No orphan files

No orphan storage

No missing foreign keys

No invalid references

All indexes healthy

====================================================
PHASE 10 — DISASTER RECOVERY
====================================================

Simulate:

Server Restart

Render Restart

Supabase Restart

CloudFront Refresh

API Restart

Network Loss

Timeout

Reconnect

Verify automatic recovery.

====================================================
PHASE 11 — LOAD TEST
====================================================

Run progressively:

100 users

500 users

1,000 users

5,000 users

10,000 users

Measure:

Latency

Errors

Memory

CPU

Database

Realtime

Recovery

====================================================
PHASE 12 — FINAL ENTERPRISE CERTIFICATION
====================================================

For EVERY module return ONLY:

PASS

PARTIAL

FAIL

If FAIL provide:

• Exact file
• Exact function
• Root cause
• Commit SHA
• Fix applied
• Deployment ID
• Runtime SHA
• Live evidence
• Screenshot
• Trace ID

====================================================
FINAL ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
====================================================

Do NOT certify production until all CRITICAL items PASS.

Required evidence:

✓ GitHub Commit SHA
✓ Render Runtime SHA
✓ Deployment ID
✓ Supabase Status
✓ CloudFront Status
✓ API Health
✓ APK Version
✓ Production URL
✓ Runtime Version
✓ Authentication Matrix
✓ Registration Matrix
✓ Reels Matrix
✓ Members Matrix
✓ Performance Metrics
✓ Security Audit
✓ Disaster Recovery
✓ Load Test Results
✓ Real Device QA
✓ Screenshots
✓ Trace IDs
✓ Production Logs

The goal is to certify IVX Holdings as a stable, owner-controlled enterprise platform with verifiable production evidence, not narrative reports.
